Method of Attack: Steals funds from accounts at over 100 banks and robs users of 32 cryptocurrency Android apps
Abuses Android Accessibility services to interact with other apps and automatically change text fields
Disables Google Play Protect to bypass Android security
Spreads by reading contact list and sending messages with APK installation link
Sends information about infected device to C2 server, reads/sends SMS, sends USSD requests, launches SOCKS5 Proxy, follows links, transfers files to C2 server, resets device to factory settings
Shows fake push notifications with icons from legitimate apps to steal credentials and initiate unauthorized transactions
Impacted Systems: Banking apps from over 100 banks including Bank of America, Bank of Scotland, J.P.Morgan, Wells Fargo, Capital One, TD Bank, PNC Bank
Cryptocurrency wallet apps including Bitcoin Wallet, BitPay, Cryptopay, Coinbase
Apps for PayPal, Western Union, eBay, Walmart, Skype, WhatsApp, Gett Taxi, Revolut
Attack Vector: APK installation file distributed via SMS messages to contacts
Command and control (C2) server distributing malware
